reviews.title: It used to work, now it doesn’t
reviews.text:
This app used to be great at syncing and streaming podcasts on my watch over cellular, so I could leave my phone behind when I go for a run.

Now that functionality has been seemingly removed. There’s an option to download podcasts on your watch “now, keeping screen on” but it’s dog slow, even on WiFi, doesn’t stream, and requires constant attention. The change is inexplicable and basically ruins all the time I invested into setting up this app the way I wanted.

reviews.title: Must Manually Delete Played Episodes
reviews.text:
Unless you listen to literally the last second of an episode, Overcast never deleted it. There isn't even an option to give priority to new episodes, for instance for news programs. Overcast will delete newer episodes rather than delete an old episode which you just never finished.

The only way around this is to periodically search for episodes you started and then manually delete them. This makes no sense and can lead to frustrating experiences, finding that you actually have no new episodes of a podcast you subscribed to when, say, you're on an airplane and don't want to pay for WiFi just to download what Overcast should have downloaded on its own.

It looks like the developer added an option to mark episodes complete if there's less than 5 minutes left, but they charge $30 *per year* for this, which is ridiculous, and it doesn't even solve the problem. How hard is it to just always delete the oldest episode, regardless of whether it's complete, not even started, or partially listened to?

And while I appreciate the day one Duo support, Overcast insists on using a split view 100% of the time on the inner screen, resulting in a podcast list that's *narrower* than a standard iPhone. You get like 6~8 words of each podcast title, and that's it. But Overcast does give itself room to show ads 100% of the time.

The only reason I don't use Apple Podcasts at this point is that Apple tries to charge a subscription for episodes which are free in literally any other Podcast app.

reviews.title: Fantastic but buggy
reviews.text:
I’ve been an Overcast user for years and years, it’s been my podcast player for most of my adult life and I have had a 5 star review on this bad boy since the beginning. I love this podcast player.

I’m downgrading the review to a 3 though because lately the app feels like it’s become much buggier. Audio often stops playing even while the podcast ticks down. Swipe actions also often trigger interaction so deleting episodes first plays them. Download failures, there’s a memory leak on the search screen where if you search, exit, and open search again you get your old search.

It’s still a great podcast player but it doesn’t feel all that reliable anymore. I hope it’s temporary and I’ll back here again with a 5 star review in a few months!

(EDIT: the feature that showed that podcasts would play via headphones apparently got dropped. I now have to tap the airplay button before hitting the play button always when listening at work. I’m starting to think I’ll be using a new podcast app next year)

I Googled and checked the Overcast subReddit and found lots of similar complaints. I also contacted the developer, but no dice. What’s so disappointing. Is that new features keep rolling out, but the core functionality is ignored.

I always loved Overcast, but I need an app I can rely on. I’ll check back at the end of this month, but if it’s not working, I have to switch.

reviews.title: Enough with vibe coding
reviews.text:
Have had Overcast on my devices for many years, though I didn’t always rush to install new versions. Earlier this year I updated my phone, and immediately regretted it. That update has completely broken the app. Five months of updates later, it’s still utterly nonfunctional. 

The main screen is nearly blank, just the new basic icons, with no obvious (or even unobvious) way to get it to start loading data again. Search doesn’t load. I can’t add new feeds. Importing the OPML file from another device does nothing. The profile screen in preferences is missing half of its functionality. I have deleted and reinstalled twice. It’s completely hosed. And there’s no way to get help, because 
Marco happily takes your money but refuses to offer even the most basic of support. It would be nice if he were present for his customers. Get off the AI slop and fix all the issues that have come up since the rewrite. 

I’m going back to Apple Podcasts.

reviews.title: Episode Limits Broken and Stress Inducing
reviews.text: Look, I get that for whatever reason, people did not like episode limit strictness. I personally don’t understand why a strict opinion was even necessary. If a limit is set by a user, then respect it. Period. Now it seems that setting an episode limit has little impact. Among my podcasts, I listen to a few that are news and opinion, and they also have hourly updates. I only ever want to listen to the latest. Now I can’t. Now I have to manually delete or fast forward through older ones (i.e in the car) after the latest finished playing. This is such a basic function that needs to work - even with automatic downloads - that I am now looking at other players or will just use Apple Podcasts. Seriously. I am also unsubscribing because it’s bad enough that an app causes stress and distraction by having to actively work around it (especially when driving). I am certainly not going to pay for that even if the sub isn’t that pricy.

reviews.title: Custom Playlists Didn’t Work For Me
reviews.text:
Important to say I hate the default Apple podcast so was excited by the rave reviews and passionate single developer backstory.

I had one simple need - different playlists which this is meant to support. I don’t know why this isn’t in apple - I feel like different listens on different days, this can’t be unusual.

Anyway off I went, installed set my basic settings and I created my History and Current Affairs playlist. Populated it with episodes by zipping back and forward from the Apple App. But of a pain but light was at the end of the tunnel.

So far impressed despite it being a little clunky I created my Drama playlist. Open it and it had all the episodes from my history playlist already populated. Odd I thought, oh well and then deleted them. Added a few drama podcasts. Went back to my History playlist. It was now my Drama playlist with a different title.

I decided to try again and found the Appear in Playlist Setting. Set one to drama, set one to News. Added episodes to Drama. Found them in News. Went back to the podcast and the found in setting hadn’t saved. Changed it again. Repeated the process and this time it did work.

Also the episodes in the Lovecraft Investigations were not in Season Order. Season 1 appears all the way down after Season 3 which I only knew from the Apple App.

My experience so far fairly buggy. Feels like I need both apps but considering the experience will probably skip this as don’t want to build lists only to find them needing to be rebuilt

reviews.title: Great app, questionable direction
reviews.text:
It had taken me a while to get to grips with the redesign. I'd finally made my peace with it and created a number of playlists. It was working okay, and then they move the goalposts again with this new hard episode limit...

It makes no sense, the previous logic was actually smarter: you decide on the limit for automatic downloads, and if you want to add more, you can. You're in control. With the new logic, whatever you set as the limit is hardcoded, and if you want to download another episode you can't unless you disable the limit entirely, which breaks automatic downloads for that episode unless you fiddle with the (already super fiddly) settings for every individual podcast before and after downloading.

Who does this help? Who thought this was a good idea? If there really is a use case, why not make it an optional setting rather than breaking everybody's playlists?

reviews.title: Downloads Don’t Work
reviews.text: There’s so much to love about this app, but ultimately, the downloads don’t work and never have. Every time I’ve gotten a new phone, I’ve had to suffer through the process of redownloading my episodes as they refuse to do so in the background. I have to keep the screen on and stay on the download queue while they take hours to download. Then the final straw this week: one of my podcasts refuses to fetch new episodes. It took a full 20 hours to be recognized in Overcast when it was available everywhere else. I tried some troubleshooting tips, including switching Sync Profiles to see if the episode showed up there (it did not) and now I’m in download hell. The app deleted all my downloads and now absolutely refuses to process the download queue no matter what I do. The only thing that works is tapping each episode individually. That is unacceptable. No amount of fancy features makes up for broken basic functionality.

reviews.title: New update ruined app :/
reviews.text:
I’ve recommended this app to many people before, and always loved it. I’ve even paid the premium subscription before in the past. 

However the recent updates have been a dealbreaker for me. The episode limits (which used to just be how many NEW episodes it would download) now apply to ALL episodes. This means that it literally won’t let you download more episodes unless you turn off the limits.

For podcasts with daily episodes, this is an absolute nightmare. I had a 1-3 episode limit for these, and I could just manually pick the ones I wanted instead of filling up my storage. However that’s not possible now, and even just a few days of this update has added over 1gb to my storage. 

There have also been some pretty annoying changes with previous updates too. For instance, if a specific episode has custom episode art, the title is pushed over to the right. Titles without custom art are justified all the way to the left. This means you can’t easily scroll a list, because the titles are now essentially in two different columns. 

I totally get that it’s just one person making this, so I know that can occasionally come with hiccups, but I’m just so confused how decisions are being made for such a popular app. It feels like the developer is just making choices based on HIS own podcasts, not what others use it for. 

I’m pretty sure something from every new update recently has had to be rolled back or fixed, which doesn’t reflect very well on however decisions are being made. 

I

reviews.title: down to two stars
reviews.text: Very sad. Before it got reorganized (aka disorganized) a few years ago, Overcast was the best podcast app. I wish they'd go back to the previous version. The organization of the current app makes 0 sense. If I follow a new podcast, there is no way to locate it again without just remembering the name of the podcast. Or if you're lucky it might randomly show up in the random cards window at the top of your app that doesn't have a clear rhyme or reason. Everything is categorized as "smart" but the actual categories don't sort by common sense logic. If the app is based on smart playlists, shouldn't the first couple options be 1. things I downloaded, labeled as such, and 2. things I follow, labeled as such? They also made it confusing to navigate to info about the podcast while listening. While I think all these features might exist in the app, it is no longer remotely intuitive. Every basic function that used to be visible and labeled is now buried, not labeled, or behind 6+ clicks through a labyrinth of more unlabeled functions.

reviews.title: Not working for me any more
reviews.text:
I have been a passionate supporter of this app for maybe 10 years.  I love the UI and the playback audio features.  But lately it has been driving me nuts !
Two principal problems : Firstly the app will not download new podcasts despite the ‘Automatic’ setting … I keep getting the ‘Waiting to Download’ message for a long time (and there are no problems with my broadband).  Second problem then shows itself … if I click Play, to stream a podcast, it will play for exactly 60 seconds, then stop … press play again and it will run for another 60 seconds and stop again, until the whole episode has downloaded (and did I say that this often takes a long time).
So sadly, unless something changes I won’t be renewing my annual subscription when it comes due !

Ultimately it seems another case of shouldn’t have fixed what wasn’t broken… shame.
